Sheet

Anatomy

Contact operator

Call operator Chat with the operator Contact support
  1. 1.dr-scrimWarm ink at 40%, never black. One scrim serves every drawer on a page, because only one row was tapped.
  2. 2.dr-sheetThe floating surface. Radius 22 on the top corners only, padding 12 / 16 / 24, gap 12, --shadow-raised. With three rows, as on tracking, it is 373.4 × 276.8 at the 375 frame (12 + 5 + 12 + 23.8 title + 12 + 3 × 44 + 12 + 44 + 24), 34.1% of the 812 frame.
  3. 3.dr-sheet__grip36 × 5 at the pill radius. It says the surface can be dragged.
  4. 4.dr-sheet__titleThe title step, 17/600, centred. It names the dialog: the sheet is role="dialog" aria-modal="true" with aria-labelledby pointing at the title. The specimen is tracking's Contact operator.
  5. 5.dr-picker__listThe options on --bg-surface at radius 16 over the sheet's page ground, the system's 1.11:1 step. Rows 341.4 × 44, HIG · 44pt exactly.
  6. 6.dr-btn--secondaryThe named Cancel that HIG · Action sheets requires, 341.4 × 44 on the secondary fill at 11.54:1.

Variants and sizes

Inventory rows: Contact drawer; Action sheet.

States

No state of its own: the sheet is a surface that holds other components. Its rows take the picker row states and its Cancel takes the button states.

When to use

The sheet is the product's floating surface. It is one of two components that take --shadow-raised; the other is the toast. The flat rule covers cards that sit in the page, and a drawer floats over it. Up to about six options rise from the bottom edge. More than that is a screen. The picker variant brings the modal contract from ui/kit.js: focus is trapped, the screen behind goes inert, Escape closes the sheet, and focus returns to the control that opened it. A field row (.dr-field--action) or a CTA (.dr-btn[aria-controls]) opens it. It stands on 31 files: the four listings files, order-setup (and -aerial, -error), order-review (all three services), report-issue, account, account-edit, operator-account, operator-listings (and -empty), job-checklist (and -error), share, the nine tracking files, and the three listings-map files as --dock.

Three modifiers have their own pages: --steady is the address picker, --tall is the filters drawer, and --dock is the sheet that does not float, on results on the map. The pay drawer is the one sheet with no title, and it is on pay list. A top-bar placement for Cancel and Done (.dr-sheet__bar) was tried for one revision and is not in components/, so it is not drawn here.

The title is the name of the row or button that opened the sheet: Parcel size, Issue type, Contact operator. Options use the user's words and the product's single word for each concept: operator, never pilot. Contact support reaches a person. Every picker sheet ends in a named Cancel (or the Done / Cancel pair), and the scrim and Escape close it without changing anything. The filters drawer ends in Clear all and Apply filters instead. One sheet is built differently: share uses a plain .dr-sheet with no --picker, open at rest, named by aria-label, and it ends in channels and a note with no Cancel.

Sources: DESIGN.md § Action sheet · § The picker row · § Elevation & Depth · inventory.md § 1 Contact drawer · microcopy.md § D6 · ui/kit.html § Sheet · scrim · grip

Rule and anti-rule

Do

Issue type

report-issue's issue type: three values, titled by the row that opened the sheet, with the current one ticked and a named Cancel under the list.

Don’t

Contact operator

Options drawn as filled buttons, with a green Done added under them. A route is a picker row, not a commit. A sheet of routes has nothing to confirm, so it ends in Cancel. If there are more than about six options, build a screen. If you only need to tell the user something, without asking them to choose, use a toast or a banner message.
